title: agentic contracts v1
description: Output of `agentic contracts --json`: the compatibility handshake. Consumers check required contract versions and features here and never infer compatibility from `agentic_version`, which is informational only.

agentic_version.description: Informational only. Not a compatibility signal.

contracts.description: Contract name to the document versions this installation emits and ships schemas for.

document_types.description: `<contract>@<version>` to the `document_type` values that contract covers.

exit_codes.description: CLI command to its stable process exit codes.
